_approach: The alternate melodigging timing (≈1.0, 2.5, 3.75): kick on beat 1, then two off-grid kicks pulled forward onto the 'and' of beat 2 and the last 16th of beat 3, leaving beat 4 open entirely - the 'more broken-beat energy' variant. Percussion answers the open beat 4 instead of the kick; hats stay sparse so the broken pocket reads clearly. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
